citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 11:10 AM on July 09
2026. After knocking on the house and kennel doors, I was able to reach the licensee by the primary contact phone
number. The licensee stated they were in Norfolk, NE and there was not an available person for facility inspection at that
time. I discussed with the licensee about attempted inspections and establishing optimal days and hours for inspection. I
subsequently departed from the facility premises at 12:05 PM.
Failure to provide access to the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations.
Continued failure to provide access is serious and may result in enforcement action.
End Section
